findings.reader: A careful, well-bounded news report: it states the group findings with their baseline, teaches points-vs-percent honestly with a flagged illustrative example, retains every causal and coverage limit, and converts the anxiety of a stalled job search into one specific, proportionate question for a career office — without diagnosing any individual or inventing a remedy.
findings.facts: All nine material claims are directly supported by the Census working paper, with magnitudes, definitions (full-quarter dominant job, 2022 reference), limitations and the review disclaimer reproduced accurately; the article adds no unsupported causal or remedial claims, and its one illustrative calculation is explicitly labelled as illustrative.
